testcase.name: the inset that comes back puts the button clear of the L, a gap inboard of its inner edge
a button already inboard of the L keeps a larger inset it was handed
an L above the button leaves the inset as it was
no L, or a map with no size yet, leaves the inset as it was
at 90 with the L on the right at its lower limit the button, as the app leaves it, sits under the L's record button
in a right-to-left layout the end edge is the left and the button clears an L snapped there
an L on the far side leaves the inset as it was
